title: Distributed Load Frequency Control of Multi-Area Smart Grid
summary: In this paper, we investigate the distributed load frequency control problem in a multi-area smart grid under external load disturbances and measurement noise. The novelty lies in that the information privacy is fully taken into account, that is, the internal structural parameters and operational states of each area are not shared with non-neighboring areas, which makes traditional distributed optimal control methods ineffective.
